name: Settlement Statblock Spreadsheet
body:
This is a spreadsheet designed to ease the creation of statblocks for settlements. It is based upon, and designed to ease the use of, the rules described in the Pathfinder RPG GameMastery Guide and on this website under Settlements. These files are intended for use with those rules.

Spreadsheets created from these templates have their automated fields and lookup tables protected against changes, to avoid confusion. However there is no password applied and if you want to change any part for your own use you can simply disable document protection.

For LibreOffice Calc or OpenOffice.org Calc use the Open Document Spreadsheet template.

For those using the ubiquitous proprietary spreadsheet application, use this version.

In future I may create, and embed here, a Google Documents version of this spreadsheet.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
